objective: Independently hammer the M451 exact K1 PWP-plus-correction adapter across exhaustive signed input pairs, fail-closed protocol attacks, persistent-old-psum semantics, upstream seals, and resource-fairness boundaries before allowing DC/Formality/PT.
resource_challenges: The adapter contains no SRAM macro or address generator, so zero new memory ports is an architectural assertion rather than RTL evidence.
Distinct PWP-cache and correction-SRAM read interfaces must be proven able to fire concurrently without a shared-bank, address-generator, or interconnect conflict.
The correction request carries tag/tile/output-block but no explicit source address; full integration must prove descriptor, polarity, source address, and PWP center alignment.
The 160-byte PWP and 96-byte correction payloads create 256 instantaneous bytes/cycle and corresponding switching even if both ports already exist.
The 96-lane signed pre-adder area, timing, latency, placement, power, and effect on Fmax are unmeasured.

opportunity_boundary.scope: four frozen H67 ep35 bottleneck Conv3x3 only

decision_rule: GO DC/Formality/PT only if the independent exhaustive arithmetic/protocol/SVA run and all seal checks pass with zero mismatch. Synopsys logic results may characterize only the standalone adapter; memory concurrency, scheduler integration, full-population replay, and matched power remain separate admission gates.
red_lines: Do not cite 1.2019906647x as RTL-measured or system speedup.
Do not claim zero new memory ports from this memory-free adapter alone.
Do not restore M426 overwrite semantics or its revoked cycle point.
